old_description: Founded in 1976, Jerry’s Electric established itself as a premier partner in the utility and industrial electrical sectors. We are a proud, family-owned American business located just outside Colman, SD. Our extensive facility enables us to ship products throughout the United States and into Canada. We focus on delivering affordable, efficient, and straightforward solutions for the sale, repair, and recycling of oil-filled electrical equipment. Our mission is to offer high-quality transformers, regulators, switchgear and repair services, ensuring exceptional speed and support. Ultimately, we aim to positively impact the lives of our customers and employees through our dedicated actions and core
about:
Jerry's Electric was founded in 1976 as a family-owned business serving the utility and industrial electrical sectors. The company operates from a facility just outside Colman, South Dakota, and ships its products throughout the United States and into Canada.

The company remanufactures transformers, voltage regulators, and switchgear, and provides repair, reclamation, and PCB analysis services for oil-filled electrical equipment. Its remanufactured transformers cover single-phase polemount units from 5 to 500 kVA, single-phase padmount units from 10 to 333 kVA, and three-phase substation and padmount transformers up to 10 MVA. All remanufactured transformers are built with new insulating oil, new copper windings, and Kraft diamond-back paper insulation, and carry a three-year warranty. The facility also performs comprehensive inspections, testing, and diagnostics, and uses gas chromatography for PCB oil analysis.

Jerry's Electric serves utility and industrial electrical customers across the U.S. and Canada, offering sale, repair, and recycling solutions for oil-filled transformers and related equipment.

The company emphasizes fast, affordable solutions without sacrificing quality, guided by values that aim to positively impact customers and employees. Its mission centers on delivering high-quality transformers, regulators, switchgear, and repair services with exceptional speed and support.

name: Jersey Metalworks, LLC
old_description: Jersey Metal Works has been crafting sheet metal products since 1992. Our fabrication services include bending and forming, welding, rolling and finishing. Jersey Metal Works will hold your specified tolerances and will fabricate to your dimensions. We are capable of working with a variety of materials up to and including 10 gauge aluminum, steel, stainless steel and other materials including some plastics.
about:
Jersey Metal Works, LLC, operates from Somerset, New Jersey. The company was founded in 1992, initially crafting steel parts and miscellaneous iron pieces for the construction industry. No founders are named, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The shop provides metal fabrication and design services, including bending, forming, welding, rolling, finishing, anodizing for aluminum railings, and custom painting. A 2008 merger with a local full-service machine shop added machining capabilities, allowing the production of custom replacement parts, one-off prototypes, and repetitive quantity runs. The facility works with materials up to 10-gauge aluminum, steel, stainless steel, and some plastics. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers span manufacturing, processing, construction, and medical-facility sectors. The company's primary service area covers New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania, though it ships throughout the United States, Canada, and internationally.

Jersey Metal Works built its reputation on precision production, timely delivery, and competitive pricing. The 2008 merger was driven by a desire to offer a more diverse product range to a broader client base, combining the creativity and craftsmanship of both operations.

name: Jet Plastics
old_description: Founded in 1948, Jet Plastics is one of the pioneers in the plastics industry.  Emerging from the need for plastics in the developing aerospace industry after the Second World War, we have established a tradition of innovation and service.  As we eagerly move forward, we are confident and determined to maintain our traditions and continue to build on our rich history.
about:
Jet Plastics operates from a facility in Los Angeles, California, where it was founded in 1948. The company emerged to supply plastic components for the rapidly expanding aerospace sector in the years following World War II, establishing itself as a pioneer in the plastics industry. Ownership structure and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom plastic profile extrusion, injection molding, and fabrication, supported by in-house tool making and secondary operations. The company also maintains an online store for stock plastic products, allowing direct purchase of standard profiles and shapes. Facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not published.

The business traces its roots to aerospace demand and continues to serve that industry, though a broader client list is not provided. The company's history page notes approaching seven decades of continuous service in plastics manufacturing, and the online store extends its reach to customers seeking standard plastic profiles.

Jet Plastics emphasizes a tradition of innovation and service built over more than seven decades, stating that there is very little in plastics manufacturing the team has not encountered. The company invites inquiries for custom extrusion, molding, and fabrication projects.

name: Jet Speed Metals
old_description: Jet Speed Metals is your trusted partner for high-quality metal distribution and fabrication. We specialize in fast-turnaround solutions for small to mid-sized businesses, job sites, and one-time orders. Whether you need stocked materials off the shelf, precision cutting from your CAD files and drawings, or custom fabrication, we deliver with speed and accuracy.
about:
Jet Speed Metals operates from Westbrook, Maine. The company was founded by entrepreneurs driven by a passion for entrepreneurship and service, aiming to fill a gap in fast-turnaround metal distribution and fabrication for smaller businesses. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a range of metal processing services: CNC plasma cutting for steel, aluminum, and other metals up to 1.25 inches thick; precision saw cutting for tubes, pipes, angles, and flat bars with bevel and miter capabilities; shearing for sheet metal up to 0.5 inches thick and 10 feet wide; ironworker services including punching, shearing, and notching; and oxy-fuel cutting for materials up to 6 inches thick. It also stocks and distributes plates, sheets, angles, and tubing, and sources additional materials as needed.

Its customer base consists of small to mid-sized businesses, job sites, and one-time orders, serving fabrication shops, structural projects, and custom metalwork needs.

The company emphasizes speed, precision, and reliability, offering same-day service on many items, quick pickup or delivery, and competitive pricing on sourced materials.

name: Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts
old_description: At Jim Coleman Automotive, we only stock parts and accessories that meet the highest standards of quality and compatibility for your vehicle. From routine maintenance to more specific repairs, we have the parts you need. And if we don’t have it, we’ll order it for you and get it to you as quickly as possible!
about:
Jim Coleman Wholesale Parts operates from Bethesda, Maryland, as the wholesale division of Jim Coleman Auto Group, a family-owned dealership network established in 1952. The Coleman family has run the business continuously since its founding, expanding from a single location in Bethesda to additional stores in Silver Spring, Clarksville, and Ellicott City.

The wholesale program supplies OEM mechanical parts, accessories, and tires to professional repair facilities. Inventory includes common maintenance items such as wiper blades, floor mats, and cargo organizers, along with a broad tire selection from Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear, and Dunlop. Orders can be placed through integrated electronic platforms — Opstrax, CollisionLink, PartsTrader, and CCCIS — as well as by phone, email, or fax. The company promises same-day or next-day delivery on stocked items and backs most purchases with a 30-day return window.

Primary customers are collision centers, mechanical repair shops, and auto body shops throughout the Washington, D.C., Maryland, and Virginia corridor. The division also supports the group’s own retail dealerships and walk-in consumers seeking genuine OEM components.

Leadership frames the operation as an extension of the group’s service-first philosophy, emphasizing long-term relationships with local businesses over transactional sales. The family-owned structure is cited as a reason for the flexibility in ordering and return policies.

name: Johnson Metal Works
old_description: Whether you’re creating a production run of components, an architectural element for a construction project, or need help bringing a napkin sketch to life, Johnson Metal Works has your back. With our experts in metal fabrication and design, you are limited only by your imagination, and sometimes not even that!
about:
Johnson Metal Works is based in Bozeman, Montana. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The shop provides a range of metal fabrication services including sheet laser cutting, tube laser cutting, forming, finishing, and field dimensioning. It also offers design engineering for manufacturability, helping customers optimize designs for cost and quality. The company works with steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, and can laser-cut aluminum up to 3/8 inch thick using its CNC equipment. A rotary-index tube laser enables precision cutting of complex profiles with repeatability for production runs. Outputs span structural and industrial fabrication, specialty construction, custom architectural elements, and Powerlift door assemblies.

Johnson Metal Works serves OEMs, architects, structural engineers, and contractors across industries such as construction, HVAC, electrical, mechanical, furniture, lighting, stair fabrication, transportation, and trailer manufacturing. Typical projects include frames, supports, railings, canopies, trusses, welded assemblies, equipment components, custom brackets for shade structures, tube-cut stringers for stairs, and components for industrial trailers.

The company states its mission is to "Empower" customers by bringing napkin sketches to production. Differentiators cited include design-for-manufacturability collaboration, the rotary-index tube laser's speed and repeatability, and the ability to cleanly cut thicker aluminum on a fiber laser system.

The shop provides laser cutting, forming, welding, and assembly, taking jobs from low-volume prototypes through high-volume production runs. Annual output exceeds one million parts, with the company reporting a 99.9 percent on-time delivery rate across its customer base of more than 150 accounts.

name: Jolys Metal Works
old_description: Joly’s Metal Works, Inc. was founded by Lucien Joly on July 9 th , 1979. Through the years, the company has tripled in size and has expanded their workload to service all of Louisiana and the coastal area. Joly’s Metal Works, Inc. employs several experienced detailers and estimators that take a job from start to finish. As a company that provides quality work, we stay up to date with all the latest technologies. We would like to thank all of our customers who have made Joly’s Metal Works, Inc. what it is today.
about:
Joly's Metal Works, Inc. was founded by Lucien Joly on July 9, 1979, in New Orleans, Louisiana. The company has grown from a small shop to a 26,500‑square‑foot facility (expanded to 28,500 square feet) serving customers across Louisiana and the Gulf Coast.

The shop specializes in general metal fabrication and installation, working with carbon steel, galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and brass in thicknesses from 26‑gauge sheet to 2‑inch plate. A team of 35 tradesmen operates two computerized cutting systems, four press brakes, four rollers, three shears, five presses, two iron workers, an automated band saw, and an 8‑by‑22‑foot automated cutting table, supported by estimators and detailers who work from customer drawings, CAD files, or hand sketches.

Joly's serves commercial and industrial clients along the Gulf Coast, providing on‑site measuring, design assistance, and a fleet of fully equipped service vehicles for installation. The company is licensed and insured, and its staff works within project specifications and timelines.

The business was started to deliver quality metalwork with up‑to‑date technology, and it emphasizes accurate, fair pricing and the ability to handle jobs of any size from a single facility.

name: Jones Plastic & Engineering
old_description: Founded in 1961, Jones Plastic & Engineering has spent decades building one of North America’s most integrated plastic manufacturing operations. From pioneering gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s to operating a dedicated robotic paint and hydrographics facility in Juarez, Mexico, Jones Plastic combines deep process knowledge with broad manufacturing capability.
about:
Jones Plastic & Engineering was founded in 1961 in Louisville, Kentucky, by brothers Harry and Larry Jones as a single-machine operation producing whiskey bottle caps. The family-owned business, now headed by the second and third generations of the Jones family, is based in Jeffersontown, Kentucky, and operates nine facilities across the United States and Mexico.

The company provides integrated plastic manufacturing services, spanning product development, tooling, injection molding (65 to 3,150 tons across five facilities), robotic painting and hydrographics, assembly, and testing. A 90,000-square-foot paint and hydrographics plant in Juárez, Mexico, includes a 25,000-square-foot clean-room line with FANUC robots and a 1.3-meter dip tank. An in-house 3D printing lab runs FDM and PolyJet systems for functional prototypes and short-run molded samples. Total manufacturing space approaches 1.6 million square feet, supported by roughly 3,000 employees. The firm also owns Rev-A-Shelf, a subsidiary producing residential cabinet storage products.

Jones Plastic serves automotive, appliance, powersports, outdoor products, consumer goods, and industrial and defense markets, supplying North American OEMs with components and assemblies that require Class-A cosmetic finishes and tight tolerances.

The company pioneered gas-assist injection molding in the early 1990s and emphasizes an engineering-first approach, using Moldex3D mold-flow analysis and finite element analysis to validate designs before tooling. Integrating molding, finishing, and assembly under one supply chain aims to reduce freight, handling, and coordination costs for near-shore production. Quality management is ISO 9001 certified.
